rows.text: compares the floats `xmm3`, `xmm2` and `xmm1` with 0.0 in that order and, for each one not below 0.0 (comiss, so NaN also skips), calls with (`rcx`, that float): `0026BB50` for `xmm3`, the call at `00239370` + 0x3D for `xmm2` and the call at `00239370` + 0x4D for `xmm1`

returns at once unless byte `rcx+3` AND `0xe0` equals `0x60`; otherwise stores `xmm1` at float `+0xe4` of the record at qword `rcx+0xb8`, re-tests the same bits, and tail-jumps to `002E86B0(rcx, that float reloaded)`
